accountServiceHint: Supports Anthropic-compatible services. The model is tested before saving. Keys are encrypted on the platform and shown only by their last four characters. Usage is billed to the service account.
actionFailed: That didn't work. Try again later
addService: Use a custom model service on a device
apiKeyHint: The key is checked against Anthropic’s model list, encrypted on the platform, and shown only by its last four characters. Usage is billed to this key.
heldEmpty: No API keys or model services
lede: Team model connections serve every project. Claude subscription credentials stay on their device; API keys and service keys are encrypted on the platform. Member ownership is a prompt instruction and does not restrict who can call an AI.
name: Name (optional)
nameHint: AI teammates using this connection follow its name.
offlineHint: The device is offline. Check again once it is online
removeBody: This login on {device} will be signed out and unavailable to the team’s AI teammates. An offline device signs out when it reconnects. Other logins are unaffected.
removeHeldBody: The key is deleted from Cheese right away, and Claude Code added to projects with it stops taking work
removedPending: No longer used. It logs out when the device comes online
revokingHint: No longer used. It logs out when {device} comes online
serviceHint: Works with services that speak Anthropic's API, such as GLM, Kimi and DeepSeek. The key is sent straight to the device and kept only there. Once saved, that device has one more model connection, using this service
title: Models
platformHint: Platform models use team credits. Availability follows the team plan.
readOnly: Team administrators manage connections and their models.
loginHint: Sign in through the desktop app on the selected device. Without the app, run the terminal command on that device.
loginOpened: Desktop app opened on the selected device. Recheck after signing in.
loginTerminal: Run in a terminal on the selected device
